faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Assistant Professor posts at Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College is 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor position across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the official website for Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College?
faq.answer: The official website for Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College is www.unishivaji.ac.in.

faq.answer: The eligibility criteria are as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra, and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be conducted as per the norms of Shivaji University, Kolhapur, and the Government of Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q8. Which subjects have vacancies for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for Assistant Professor in Marathi, Hindi, Education, Commerce, and Economics.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website: www.unishivaji.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College?
faq.answer: Bhai Tukaram Kolekar College is located in Nesari, Maharashtra, with the pincode 416504.
